morning3_start.name: {name}
morning3_start.text: *Day three. I overslept. I turned off my alarm three times. Stayed up late texting last night.*

morning3_start_2.name: {name}
morning3_start_2.text: *I sprint down the road to school. — The school gate comes into view. And then.*

morning3_seo_gate_1.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_1.text: *Seoyeon is standing in front of the gate. Not in any hurry.*

morning3_seo_gate_4.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_4.text: So what if we're late? If we get caught together, maybe the punishment won't be so bad?

morning3_seo_gate_5.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_5.text: I don't think that's how it works.

morning3_seo_gate_7.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_7.text: *Seoyeon walks ahead. Confidently. She doesn't rush, even though she's late. — This girl is poised even when she's tardy. No, it's more like acting poised is second nature to her.*

morning3_yuna_gate_1.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_1.text: *I spot Yuna standing blankly in front of the gate. Her eyes are half-closed.*

morning3_yuna_gate_5.name: Yuna
morning3_yuna_gate_5.text: ...I had to know the ending. I couldn't stop.

morning3_yuna_gate_6.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_6.text: *Someone who stays up all night reading and ends up late. — Admirable or hopeless, either way, that's so Yuna. I like that.*

morning3_yuna_gate_7.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_7.text: *Yuna pulls a small bread roll from her bag. We share it as we slowly walk through the gate.*

morning3_dain_gate_1.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_1.text: *Near the gate, Dain comes sprinting at full speed.*

morning3_dain_gate_2.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_2.text: Hey hey hey!! We're late!! Run!!

morning3_dain_gate_3.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_3.text: *Dain grabs my hand without warning and starts running.*

morning3_dain_gate_4.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_4.text: Wait — why are you holding my hand?!

morning3_dain_gate_5.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_5.text: *Her hand is warm. Is it sweat, or is it because of Dain? — No time to think while running.*

morning3_classroom_1.name: {name}
morning3_classroom_1.text: *As I enter the classroom, I feel the stares of the other two who saw who I arrived with.*

morning3_react_seo_1.name: Dain
morning3_react_seo_1.text: Hey! You came with the class president?! This early in the morning?!

morning3_react_seo_2.name: {name}
morning3_react_seo_2.text: *Yuna turns her gaze from the window, glances this way briefly. — Then back to the window.*

morning3_react_yuna_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_react_yuna_1.text: Walking to school together? You two seem close.

morning3_react_yuna_2.name: Dain
morning3_react_yuna_2.text: So jealous!! I wish I had someone to walk to school with too!!

morning3_react_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_react_dain_1.text: Quite the cardio workout this morning. Want me to share my lunch box later?

morning3_react_dain_2.name: {name}
morning3_react_dain_2.text: *Yuna is quietly observing. It looks like she's writing a note.*

morning3_date_intro.name: {name}
morning3_date_intro.text: *First period ends. Break time. — It's not like they all rush me at once. But today, someone keeps finding the exact moment to talk to me.*

morning3_date_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_date_seo_1.text: Are you free this weekend? There's somewhere I want to go.

morning3_date_seo_choice.name: {name}
morning3_date_seo_choice.text: *Seoyeon asks casually as she passes me in the hallway.*
choices: I think I'll be kind of busy

morning3_date_seo_accept.name: {name}
morning3_date_seo_accept.text: *I accepted the weekend plans with Seoyeon.*

morning3_date_dain_1.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_1.text: Hey! What are you doing this weekend?! Wanna hit the arcade together?!

morning3_date_dain_2.name: {name}
morning3_date_dain_2.text: *Dain's fingers are tapping the edge of the desk. Is she nervous? — No way. Dain doesn't get nervous. This is just everyday stuff for her.*

morning3_date_dain_choice.name: {name}
morning3_date_dain_choice.text: *Dain comes over during the next break and asks.*

morning3_date_dain_accept.name: {name}
morning3_date_dain_accept.text: *I accepted the weekend plans with Dain.*

morning3_date_dain_decline.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_decline.text: Oh, okay? Well, if you're busy, can't be helped!

morning3_date_dain_decline_narr.name: {name}
morning3_date_dain_decline_narr.text: *I watch Dain's reaction. — The bell rings, and the short lull right before lunch comes around again.*

morning3_date_dain_decline_inner.name: {name}
morning3_date_dain_decline_inner.text: *She walked away with a bright smile. — I didn't realize it then. That Dain had stopped tapping her fingers and slipped her hands into her pockets. That it had taken courage to ask.*

morning3_date_dain_decline_inner_2.name: {name}
morning3_date_dain_decline_inner_2.text: *I pride myself on being perceptive. — Yet I get it wrong at the moments that matter most.*

morning3_date_yuna_1.name: {name}
morning3_date_yuna_1.text: *Just before lunch, a note from Yuna is waiting on my desk.*

morning3_date_yuna_2.name: {name}
morning3_date_yuna_2.text: *'Weekend. Going to the used bookstore. Come if you want. — Yuna'*

morning3_date_yuna_choice.name: {name}
choices: I fold the note and put it in my pocket

morning3_date_yuna_accept.name: {name}
morning3_date_yuna_accept.text: *I accepted the weekend plans with Yuna.*

morning3_date_yuna_decline.name: {name}
morning3_date_yuna_decline.text: *I quietly folded the note and slipped it into my pocket. No reply written. — Yuna lowered her head slightly. She seemed to understand.*

morning3_set_multiple.name: {name}
morning3_set_multiple.text: *...Wait. My weekend plans are overlapping. What do I do now.*

morning3_end.name: {name}
morning3_end.text: *My weekend plans are overlapping... Before I know it, classes continue and lunchtime approaches.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_1.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_1.text: *Break time. Passing by an empty classroom — I hear someone inside. I approach quietly.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_2.text: *The homeroom teacher is sitting at the desk, writing something. She stops and looks up. — Our eyes meet.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_4.text: ...It's nothing. Work documents. — ...Being observant is usually a strength. Sometimes it's a weakness.

hidden_homeroom_d3_choice.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_choice.text: *That's manuscript paper. She has the face of someone who's been caught.*
choices: I saw it's manuscript paper. — Are you writing a novel?

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1.text: ...Too embarrassing to call it a novel. Too old to call it practice. Seven years.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2.text: Started in college. Creative writing major. After graduating, I applied for literary awards — got rejected three times over two years.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3.text: Took the teaching exam. Korean language teacher. — A would-be novelist teaching literature. Ironic, right?

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4.text: It'd be easier to say I gave up. But I keep pulling it out in empty classrooms like this — so I guess I never really did.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice.text: *Seven years. The manuscript paper on the desk is worn thin.*
choices: Seven years isn't giving up — that's persistence
Why do you always write here?

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_a.text: *She can't find her words for a moment.* ...Persistence. You're the first person to see it that way.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_b.text: ...The classroom is the quietest place. Ironic, isn't it.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_5.text: *Suddenly serious.* ...Don't tell anyone about this. A teacher sharing this with a student — it's a secret.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6.text: *She smiles. Not her usual dry one — slightly awkward. — ...First reader applicant in seven years.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_hide_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_hide_1.text: ...Right, just pretend you didn't see anything. Please. — ...Thanks.

hidden_homeroom_d3_end.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_end.text: *She tucks her hair behind her ear and leaves. — 'Please' is a rare word from her.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.text: *Talking with the homeroom teacher in the empty classroom.*
hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.context: Day 3 morning. Discovered the teacher writing a novel manuscript in an empty classroom. A secret she's kept for 7 years. Tone: Bright on the surface but shadows underneath. Sometimes smiling but eyes aren't. Sincerity peeks through casual conversation.
hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.personality: The teacher was an aspiring novelist. Became a teacher but never let go of the dream. A mix of embarrassment and relief at being found out.

hidden_nurse_d3_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_1.text: *Something feels off since this morning. My feet take me to the nurse's office. I'm not even hurt.*

hidden_nurse_d3_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_2.text: ...Huh? What'd you hurt today? — You're not hurt but you came to the nurse's office?

hidden_nurse_d3_3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_3.text: ...I just wanted to rest. Relationships are getting complicated.

hidden_nurse_d3_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_4.text: ...Sit down. Seriously, you look rough. What's going on?

hidden_nurse_d3_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5.text: Is this a relationship consultation? — Pretending it's not is the biggest giveaway.

hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_a.text: ...Similar? Then it's good you came here.

hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_b.text: *Pulls up a chair and sits down.* Relationships. — Is this a love consultation? *Pfft.* The more you try to hide it, the more obvious it is.

hidden_nurse_d3_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6.text: When I worked at the hospital. Too many patients. I wanted to save everyone, but I only have two hands. Eventually it felt like I couldn't properly care for even one.

hidden_nurse_d3_7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_7.text: That's why I came here. At school — I can actually give each person proper attention.

hidden_nurse_d3_8.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_8.text: Same goes for you. Don't try to take care of everyone. — Wouldn't it be better to really see the one person who matters most?

hidden_nurse_d3_choice2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_choice2.text: *One person, properly — it doesn't sound like she's only talking about the hospital.*
choices: Is that why you left the hospital?
Do you have that one person too?

hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_b.text: ...There was one. A patient I couldn't save.

hidden_nurse_d3_9.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_9.text: ...The one who matters most. What if that's your teacher?

hidden_nurse_d3_10.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_10.text: *...What? — I turned around. The nurse is staring out the window. She's not smiling. It's the first time I've seen that expression.*

hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.text: *Talking with the school nurse in the nurse's office.*
hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.context: Day 3. Came to the nurse's office feeling anxious. The nurse had a serious heart-to-heart, including her hospital burnout backstory. Tone: Bright on the surface but shadows underneath. Sometimes smiling but eyes aren't. Sincerity peeks through casual conversation.
hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.personality: Usually playful, but when serious the whole atmosphere changes. A professional with burnout experience. Torn between feelings and her title.

morning3_seo_gate_warm_1.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_warm_1.text: *Seoyeon is waiting at the gate. Unusually, she seems like she came early.*

morning3_seo_gate_warm_2.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_warm_2.text: ...I didn't come early. Student council business.

morning3_seo_gate_warm_3.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_warm_3.text: *Her hands are empty. No papers, no clipboard.*

morning3_seo_gate_warm_4.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_warm_4.text: *Seoyeon starts walking alongside me without a word. — Was the distance from the gate to the classroom always this short?*

morning3_seo_gate_cold_2.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_cold_2.text: ...Transfer student. Still coming to school, huh.

morning3_seo_gate_cold_3.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_cold_3.text: *Her tone is businesslike. Seoyeon walks past the gate, her back getting smaller.*

morning3_yuna_gate_warm_1.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_warm_1.text: *Yuna is leaning against the wall by the gate. She hands me a note.*

morning3_yuna_gate_warm_4.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_warm_4.text: *Walking side by side with Yuna. No words. — But strangely, the silence is comfortable.*

morning3_yuna_gate_cold_1.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_cold_1.text: *Yuna walks past first. Our eyes meet, but she turns away.*

morning3_yuna_gate_cold_2.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_cold_2.text: *Her pace quickens. — It feels like the wall is going back up.*

morning3_dain_gate_warm_1.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_warm_1.text: *Dain runs up and links her arm with mine.*

morning3_dain_gate_warm_2.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_warm_2.text: Hey! You almost made us late! Let's go together!

morning3_dain_gate_warm_3.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_warm_3.text: *Dain's arm is wrapped around mine. She's strong. — I can't shake her off, and I don't want to.*

morning3_dain_gate_cold_1.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_cold_1.text: *Dain runs past with her other friends.*

morning3_date_intro_b.name: {name}
morning3_date_intro_b.text: *I step into the hallway for break. Seoyeon is the first to fall into step beside me.*

morning3_date_seo_accept_b.name: {name}
morning3_date_seo_accept_b.text: *I head back to the classroom. One class passes, and another short break arrives.*

morning3_date_seo_decline_b.name: {name}
morning3_date_seo_decline_b.text: *I head back to the classroom. One class passes, and another short break arrives.*

morning3_seo_gate_6_ins.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_6_ins.text: *Seoyeon walks on. Confidently. She doesn't rush, even though she's late.*

morning3_yuna_gate_6_ins.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_6_ins.text: *Yuna rummages through her bag without a word, pulls out a small bread roll, tears it in half, and offers it. A note peeks out from inside her bag.*

morning3_yuna_gate_6_ins2.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_6_ins2.text: *The note: I figured you hadn't eaten breakfast.*

morning3_yuna_gate_6_ins3.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_6_ins3.text: *Someone who writes notes when she could just say it out loud. — That's Yuna.*

morning3_dain_gate_4_ins.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_4_ins.text: This is faster!! Don't question it!!

morning3_dain_gate_5_ins.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_5_ins.text: *The moment we crossed the gate, Dain landed and let out a small ngh. But when I looked back, she was smiling like nothing happened. — Did I mishear?*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_ins.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_ins.text: *Break between second and third period. On the way back from the restroom — I see a light in the empty classroom at the end of the hallway.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_ins2.text: *An empty classroom at this hour? — Someone's in there.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_ins3.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_ins3.text: *I approach quietly. The door is slightly ajar. — The homeroom teacher is sitting at the desk, writing something.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_ins4.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_ins4.text: *Those aren't official documents. It's manuscript paper. — The same stack I saw in the staff room drawer yesterday.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_ins5.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_ins5.text: *The teacher stops writing and looks up. — Our eyes meet.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_3_ins.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_3_ins.text: *Half a second. Frozen. — It's an expression I've never seen on the teacher before. Not indifferent, not dry. The face of someone who's been caught.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_3_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_3_ins2.text: *The teacher quickly flips the manuscript paper face-down.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_ins2.text: Work documents in an empty classroom?

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_ins3.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_ins3.text: *The teacher closes her mouth for a moment. Then — sighs. Briefly.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_ins4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_ins4.text: ...Being perceptive is usually a strength. Sometimes it's a flaw.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_ins5.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_ins5.text: *The teacher pauses. She fingers the manuscript paper. — Then leans back in her chair.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_ins2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_ins2.text: Seven years. *Looking out the window* Started in college. Creative writing major.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_ins4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_ins4.text: After graduating, I tried to debut as a writer — failed three times over two years. Money ran out, parents said 'time to be realistic.'

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_ins5.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_ins5.text: *The teacher lifts a sheet of manuscript paper. It's covered in dense handwriting.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3_ins2.text: *The teacher sets the manuscript paper down. Slowly.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_ins.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_ins.text: *So this is the story behind her dry demeanor. — An unfinished manuscript in the teacher's desk drawer. Seven years.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_ins2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_ins2.text: *Suddenly serious* ...You can't tell anyone about this. If a student knew their teacher's — this side, my authority — well, I never had much to begin with.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_ins4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_ins4.text: *Tucking her hair back* It's a secret. — Not exactly a good educational example. Telling a student something like this.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_ins5.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_ins5.text: *'Educational.' — She's wrapping it in work talk again. But this time, the tone carries genuine regret.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_ins6.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_ins6.text: I'd like to read it, though. Your novel.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins.text: ...My first volunteer reader. In seven years.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins2.text: *The smile is awkward. — Is she awkward at smiling, or has she forgotten how?*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins3.text: *She hesitates. The hand touching the manuscript paper stops.* ...You're the first person to call it perseverance.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins4.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins4.text: *She called seven years 'not being able to give up.' But one sentence that shifted her perspective — and her eyes wavered.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins5.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins5.text: It's quiet here. — The staff room smells like coffee and everyone's watching.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins6.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins6.text: *The reason she chose an empty classroom is practical, but it also means — she's someone who needs a space of her own.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins7.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_ins7.text: *It feels like I've opened a hidden drawer behind the title of 'teacher.' I should close it — but I can't let go.*

hidden_nurse_d3_2_ins.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_2_ins.text: *The teacher uses the word 'please.' — For her, that's a rare word.*

hidden_nurse_d3_2_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_2_ins2.text: *I leave the classroom — and from behind, quietly.*

hidden_nurse_d3_2_ins4.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_2_ins4.text: *I'm not sure what she's thanking me for. For not looking away? Or — for coming this far?*

hidden_nurse_d3_2_ins5.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_2_ins5.text: *Right before lunch. — My mind hasn't settled all morning. Too many faces, too many words. Is that it? I don't know why I'm this shaken this fast.*

hidden_nurse_d3_1_ins2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_1_ins2.text: *Looking up* ...Hm? Where are you hurt today?

hidden_nurse_d3_1_ins4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_1_ins4.text: Not hurt but coming to the nurse's office?

hidden_nurse_d3_1_ins5.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_1_ins5.text: ...I just wanted to rest a bit.

hidden_nurse_d3_3_ins.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_3_ins.text: *The nurse looks at me for a moment. The playfulness vanishes.*

hidden_nurse_d3_3_ins3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_3_ins3.text: *Her voice changed. Not joking anymore. — When this person gets serious, the whole atmosphere shifts.*

hidden_nurse_d3_3_ins4.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_3_ins4.text: *I sit on the bed. The nurse hands me a glass of water.*

hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins2.text: ...Something like that? Then it's good you came here.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins3.text: *One 'something like that' and her whole attitude changed. — She's someone who opens up when she feels understood.*

hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins5.text: *Pulling up a chair and sitting across from me* Relationships.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins6.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins6.text: I'm worried about multiple people at once, but I feel like I have to choose just one...

hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins7.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins7.text: *The nurse is silent for a moment. Then.*

hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins10.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins10.text: *Smirks* Pretending it's not is the most obvious giveaway.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins11.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins11.text: *Bull's-eye. — Her observation skills are no joke.*

hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins12.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins12.text: Should a school nurse even be doing this kind of counseling... *Resting her chin on her hand* But I'll listen. This is the nurse's office, after all. Your heart needs to be healthy too, right?

hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins13.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins13.text: Have you ever felt that way? Torn between multiple people?

hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins14.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins14.text: *The nurse pauses. Her gaze drifts to the window.*

hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins15.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_ins15.text: ...Yeah. Back when I worked at the university hospital.

hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins.text: *She's talking about patients, but somehow it overlaps with my situation.*

hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins2.text: *The nurse sets down her water glass. Slowly.*

hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins3.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins3.text: ...It wasn't so much quitting. I ran away. *With a faint smile* There's no glamorous reason.

hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins4.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins4.text: *She uses the word 'ran away' herself. — This person is used to acknowledging her own weakness.*

hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins5.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins5.text: *The nurse pauses. She touches her stethoscope.*

hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins6.text: ...There was one. A patient I couldn't save. *Her gaze drifts.* That person is why I'm here.

hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins7.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_6_ins7.text: *One person. — That one person changed her whole life.*

hidden_nurse_d3_8_ins.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_ins.text: *She means it. The playfulness is completely gone. — When her voice drops a tone, that's her signal of sincerity.*

hidden_nurse_d3_8_ins3.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_8_ins3.text: *Playful again* Oh please~ This much is on the house. — Come again anytime. Hurt or not.

hidden_nurse_d3_8_ins4.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_ins4.text: *'Hurt or not.' — Is she starting to see me as something other than a patient?*

hidden_nurse_d3_8_ins5.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_ins5.text: *I leave the nurse's office — and from behind, quietly.*

hidden_nurse_d3_9_ins.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_9_ins.text: *...What? — My feet stopped. Only the smell of disinfectant hangs heavy in the air.*

hidden_nurse_d3_9_ins3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_9_ins3.text: *The nurse — isn't smiling. She's fidgeting with her stethoscope, looking out the window. Like someone who didn't even realize what she just said.*

hidden_nurse_d3_9_ins5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_9_ins5.text: *Barely managing a smile* Just kidding~ Get going!

hidden_nurse_d3_9_ins7.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_9_ins7.text: *I tell myself it must be, but my feet won't move. That 0.7-second expression just now — there was no playfulness in it.*

hidden_nurse_d3_9_ins8.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_9_ins8.text: *The smell of disinfectant suddenly grew stronger. One more step from here — and I might not be able to call her 'teacher' anymore.*

morning3_date_yuna_1_ins.name: Seoyeon
morning3_date_yuna_1_ins.text: The rolled omelette is a bit too salty. 6 points.
